excerpt: A Practical Compliance Guide for Employers to Avoid Costly LMIA and Work Permit Mistakes Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. Hiring skilled foreign workers in Canada can give your business a competitive advantage, but it also comes with responsibilities. Canadian employers must follow specific rules when applying for a Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) and managing work permits. Failure to comply with these rules can lead to fines, application refusals, inspections, or even bans on hiring foreign workers.
